issues.title: Move the dollar format into one function
issues.body:
The dollar format `$D.CC` is written twice: in `format_line` in `inventory/report.py`, and in the `total` command in `inventory/cli.py`. Move it into one function, so that a later change to the format happens in one place. This is a refactor: the output must not change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `inventory/money.py` defines `format_money(cents)`, which returns the amount in the form `$D.CC`; for example, `format_money(5)` returns `$0.05`.
- [ ] `report.py` and `cli.py` both call `format_money`, and neither holds its own copy of the dollar format.
- [ ] The output of `inventory list` and `inventory total` does not change.
